prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers. He holds a black smartphone.

summary:
[reference generation] After a brief motion-blur transition, a close shot of <Subject 1> in the bright convenience store, reading his phone and smiling with restrained confidence.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and soft highlight roll-off, in clean cool-white store light with crisp silver-blue highlights.
[Shot 1] The shot opens with a brief, controlled horizontal motion blur of bright white and blue light streaks that resolves within the first half second into a close shot of <Subject 1>, framed from the chest up and turned three-quarters toward the camera, standing in the convenience store. He wears his plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under the unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt, and his natural short black hair and straight dark eyebrows are sharp. He holds a black smartphone in his right hand at chest height and looks down at its screen, which faces away from the camera. Behind him, bright white shelves and the glowing glass doors of the drinks refrigerators are softly blurred into shapes of white, silver and blue. The even, cool store light falls on his face from above, with a soft glow from the phone on his chin. He makes one small upward thumb movement on the screen and reads quietly for a moment. Then a restrained, confident smile appears: the corners of his mouth lift slightly and his eyes brighten, while his posture stays relaxed. His lips stay together. The camera stays nearly fixed in a static shot after the opening blur. In the final half second, the whole image softens slightly, as if beginning to dissolve. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Low store ambience and a soft refrigeration hum continue under a faint scroll sound from the phone.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads with a soft low pulse and light, bright electronic plucks, kept low in volume.
